experiments.study_type: Form deprivation myopia induction and recovery; single-cell RNA-seq of choroid
experiments.procedure_text: Form deprivation myopia induced in chicks via translucent goggle on right eye for 10 days, then 24 hr recovery; choroids analyzed.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Form deprivation myopia (FDM) was induced in 3 to 4 day-old chicks by applying translucent plastic goggles to the right eye
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: control and recovering eyes of ten chicks each were pooled separately
experiments.test_system_evidence: Choroids were isolated... subjected to single cell RNA sequencing and bioinformatic analysis

endpoints.label: Choroid cell cluster transcriptomic identification (scRNA-seq)
endpoints.evidence: subjected to single cell RNA sequencing and bioinformatic analysis

endpoints.label: Differential gene expression between control and recovering choroids
endpoints.evidence: Genes that were significantly up or down-regulated in 3 or more choroid cell clusters

substances.evidence: euthanized by an overdose of isoflurane inhalant anesthetic (IsoThesia; Vetus Animal Health)

exposure.duration: Goggles remained in place for 10 days
exposure.timing: allowed to experience unrestricted vision (recover) for 24 hrs
exposure.conditions: translucent plastic goggles to the right eye

experiments.exposure_evidence: Goggles remained in place for 10 days
experiments.notes: Form deprivation is a physical visual manipulation, not a chemical administration; no administration route applies. Myopia/choroid biology study.
